subject: Request: One-time packaging concession for beta expansion — VP/CFO sign-off
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: One-time packaging concession for beta expansion — VP/CFO sign-off
Attachments: beta_pricing_model.xlsx

Team — quick summary and ask below. I met with MedPilot (Catherine) this morning; they're ready to sign a 3-month beta across three product teams (approx 75 seats, heavy embedding usage for search). The catch: they need a non-standard onboarding/packaging structure to make the pilot financially viable for them.

Proposal (customer asks):
- One-time onboarding credit: 35% applied to first invoice
- Custom per-embedding price for first 6 months (50% of published rate)
- Temporary seat-mix (starter seats + compute seats) and revised consumption floor waived for the pilot

Business justification: high strategic value — if successful this pilot converts to an enterprise commitment with expansion potential (estimated $1.2M ARR in 18 months). HubSpot deal id: 87654321. I modeled the numbers in the attached beta_pricing_model.xlsx (sensitivity tab included).

Ask: we need VP/CFO signoff for a one-time packaging concession and ability to execute a short SOW next week. Legal will require the run-rate reversion language; finance needs direction if we should accept a 35% onboarding credit or cap it. Can you please review and sign off (or propose edits) by EOD Thursday, 5/6 PT?

Thanks — Priyom
-- 
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-time packaging concession for beta expansion — VP/CFO sign-off
Attachments: SOW_draft.pdf; exec_concession_memo.docx

Priyom — reviewed the model, attaching a redlined SOW draft and a short executive memo that frames the risk/reward. Key points from my review:
- Upside: 3 pilots across distinct product areas inside MedPilot increases probability of full-platform adoption. Modeled expansion scenarios show upside outweighs initial concession if conversion > 30%.
- Downside: front-loaded credits and a reduced per-embedding rate materially depress near-term gross margin; need stronger reversion language and explicit usage milestones.

Recommendation: approve a one-time concession but limit the onboarding credit to a dollar cap (not to exceed $45k), and make the discounted per-embedding rate timeboxed to 6 months with automatic reversion. I flagged language in exec_concession_memo.docx. If ops wants to keep a percent instead of dollar cap, suggest 25% (compromise).

Please escalate to Naomi for finance signoff and Jonas for legal/ops clause review.

-Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-time packaging concession for beta expansion — VP/CFO sign-off

Thanks — read both. A few operational asks from my side before I can bless the SOW: 
- Tighten the reversion mechanics: propose explicit thresholds (e.g., >$75k MRR run-rate or >1.2M tokens/mo) that trigger continued custom pricing; otherwise automatic reversion to published rates after 6 months.
- Add a clause that the pilot is non-recurring: any permanent pricing change requires a formal renewal with Marketplace/Finance signoff.
- Require an audit window and reporting cadence (monthly usage reports and a joint review at month 3).

I also suggest we replace the 35% percent onboarding credit with either a capped dollar credit (Marissa's $45k cap) or 25% — to be decided by Naomi. Legal will take the SOW draft after finance confirms the cap.

Jonas
--
Jonas Weber
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: One-time packaging concession for beta expansion — VP/CFO signoff

Team — after running the numbers and considering revenue/profitability tradeoffs, CFO approval granted with modifications. Approvals and required conditions below: 

Approved concessions (with modifications):
- Onboarding credit: APPROVED at a firm cap of $45,000 (not a %). Finance will record as one-time contra-revenue.
- Discounted per-embedding price: APPROVED for 6 months only; this rate will revert to standard published pricing automatically after 6 months unless the customer meets the usage threshold described below.
- Temporary seat-mix/consumption floor waiver: APPROVED for the 3-month pilot only.

Conditions (must be reflected in SOW):
1) Usage threshold for extended pricing: customer must reach a sustained run-rate of $75,000 MRR (or equivalent token usage > 1.2M tokens/month) by month 6; otherwise pricing reverts.
2) Dollar credit ($45k) is drawn down on first invoice and is non-refundable.
3) Monthly usage reporting and a joint review at month 3 and month 6.
4) Legal to add audit rights and a fallback to default SLAs if usage exceeds thresholds without a signed renewal.

Next steps: Priyom — proceed to get the customer to sign the attached SOW. Jonas, please incorporate the above conditions and re-send to me for a final look. Marissa — update the exec memo to reflect the $45k cap and link the HubSpot deal (87654321) in the SOW. Finance will create the contra-revenue line once DocuSign is complete.

Approved by: Naomi Feldman, VP Finance (on behalf of CFO)
--
Naomi Feldman
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
